derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G1252 (διακρίνω);

occurrences.text: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.
